name: RapVid
tagline: Turn one photo into a lip-synced rap video with AI
description: RapVid is an AI rap video maker that turns one photo into a lip-synced rap performance. Pick a viral rap effect, choose 5, 10 or 15 seconds, and generate a shareable rap music video with an original beat in minutes. No camera, no studio and no editing skills needed. Post it to TikTok, Reels or Shorts.
